subjects.request: ONE plain utilitarian GAS MASK in front view, paired with TWO thick MARSH REEDS at one side. Two broad black eye lenses, one large round front filter with two broad cuts; three blunt reed leaves only. Grim contaminated-swamp hunter emblem, no face inside, hoses, fine filter mesh, radiation lettering, skulls, blood or texture.

subjects.request: ONE large OPEN BOOK with only TWO wide black page-fold cuts, above ONE simple THREE-TOWER CITY SKYLINE. Broad solid city blocks without tiny windows, clean black gap between book and skyline. Education, civilization and trade; no torch statue, letters, dollar sign, logos, rays or fine architectural detail.

subjects.request: ONE natural bare CLENCHED FIST raised above ONE short BROKEN HEAVY CHAIN with exactly TWO broad oval links separated at center. Two wide finger cuts, one complete wrist. Harsh strength and loyalty born from prison ancestry, no face, portrait, gang initials, tattoo, weapon, gore, fine texture or tiny chain links.
